"""Read-only native reopened scene acceptance, no new construction."""
import bpy,json,math,hashlib,struct
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
from bpy_extras.object_utils import world_to_camera_view
ROOT=Path('EVIDENCE_ROOT/houdini-blender-lighting');receipt=json.loads((ROOT/'lighting-receipt.json').read_text());s=bpy.context.scene
assert set(o.name for o in s.objects)==set(receipt['objects'])
for name,r in receipt['objects'].items():
 o=s.objects[name];assert o.type==r['type'];assert max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(o.location,r['location']))<1e-6;assert max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(o.rotation_euler,r['rotation']))<1e-6
obj=s.objects['HoudiniCeramic'];assert len(obj.data.vertices)==115776 and len(obj.data.polygons)==115200
assert s.view_settings.view_transform=='AgX' and s.view_settings.look=='AgX - Medium High Contrast' and s.view_settings.exposure==0 and s.view_settings.gamma==1
assert s.camera.name=='StudyCamera' and s.camera.data.lens==85 and not s.camera.data.dof.use_dof
assert obj.data.materials[0].name=='BlenderTealGlaze';assert s.objects['StudioFloor'].data.materials[0].name=='WarmStudioFloor'
assert s.render.resolution_x==1200 and s.render.resolution_y==1500 and s.cycles.samples==64 and not s.cycles.use_denoising
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
projected=[world_to_camera_view(s,s.camera,obj.matrix_world@Vector(c)) for c in obj.bound_box]
assert all(.08<=p.x<=.92 and .08<=p.y<=.92 and p.z>0 for p in projected)
h=hashlib.sha256()
for v in obj.data.vertices:h.update(struct.pack('<3f',*v.co))
assert h.hexdigest()==json.loads((ROOT/'import-validation.json').read_text())['positions_sha256']
for name,power,size,color in [('KeySoftbox',700,3.5,[1,.9,.78]),('FillSoftbox',220,3.,[.72,.85,1]),('RimSoftbox',500,2.5,[1,.95,.86])]:
 light=s.objects[name].data;assert light.energy==power and light.type=='AREA' and light.shape=='DISK' and light.size==size;assert max(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(light.color,color))<1e-6
for name,color,roughness in [('BlenderTealGlaze',[.035,.23,.19,1],.26),('WarmStudioFloor',[.26,.22,.18,1],.65)]:
 b=bpy.data.materials[name].node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF');assert max(abs(a-v) for a,v in zip(b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value,color))<1e-6;assert abs(b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value-roughness)<1e-6
glaze=bpy.data.materials['BlenderTealGlaze'].node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF');assert abs(glaze.inputs['Coat Weight'].default_value-.3)<1e-6 and abs(glaze.inputs['Coat Roughness'].default_value-.18)<1e-6
print(json.dumps({'saved_reopened':True,'counts':[len(obj.data.vertices),len(obj.data.polygons)],'positions_sha256':h.hexdigest(),'scope':'new cross-DCC lighting final only','render':[1200,1500,64]}))

assert s.render.image_settings.file_format=='OPEN_EXR_MULTILAYER'
assert s.view_layers['ViewLayer'].cycles.denoising_store_passes
assert s.render.image_settings.color_depth=='32' and s.render.image_settings.exr_codec=='ZIP'
floor=s.objects['StudioFloor'];assert len(floor.data.vertices)==4 and len(floor.data.polygons)==1
assert all(abs(abs(v.co.x)-100)<1e-6 and abs(abs(v.co.y)-100)<1e-6 and abs(v.co.z)<1e-6 for v in floor.data.vertices)
origin=s.camera.matrix_world.translation
for corner in s.camera.data.view_frame(scene=s):
 ray=s.camera.matrix_world.to_3x3()@corner
 assert ray.z<0
 t=-origin.z/ray.z;point=origin+ray*t
 assert t>0 and abs(point.x)<99 and abs(point.y)<99
print(json.dumps({'floor_camera_frustum_covered':True,'true_denoising_passes':True}))
